title: Onboard helios-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context: We need to onboard the new open-model release 'helios-13b v1.0' into the model registry so it can be served by Redwood with validated performance profiles and appear in automated changelogs. This PR adds canonical metadata, performance profiles (latency/cost/kvcache), and updates the changelog generation pipeline to pick up new model metadata tags.

What this PR does:
- Adds model metadata for helios-13b v1.0 including architecture, recommended tokenizer, license, and sample inference configs.
- Adds performance profile JSONs generated from the benchmark-lab runs (p95 latency, throughput, memory, recommended batching and quantization knobs).
- Hooks model metadata into the changelog automation: new models with "registry:published" flag will be included in the generated release notes.
- Minor docs update to the model-registry README describing the fields required for automatic changelog inclusion.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata file with required fields (name, version, architecture, license, tokenizer)
- [x] Performance profile added and sanity-checked against benchmark-lab output
- [x] Changelog generator updated + unit tests
- [x] Docs updated
- [x] CI green and reviewers approved

Why: Helios is a competitive 13B model that matches our supported architecture patterns. Onboarding it with validated perf profiles enables engineers to target a low-latency default and gives product visibility in release notes automatically.

Notes on validation: perf numbers were derived from runs in benchmark-lab/experiments/helios-13b/2025-11-12 using the dedicated 8xA100-80GB profile. We include fallback quantization recommendations (int8/4-bit) and a recommended default config for hosted and dedicated deployments.
commits: Hook changelog generator to detect registry:published metadata flag and include model entries
Add unit tests for changelog detection and model metadata validation
Docs: update model-registry README with automatic-changelog section
Fix: add license and tokenizer fields after reviewer feedback
CI: address lint errors in changelog script (style + type hints)

release_notes: Onboarded model: helios-13b v1.0. Includes validated performance profiles for dedicated 8xA100-80GB runs, recommended batching & quantization settings, and automatic inclusion in generated model registry changelogs when published.
